Name: Ran's Hearts
Author: ranfuu
Description:
[b]FEATURES:
[/b]- Three main heart styles: "stardew", "hm", "sos" + bonus "hm_pink" that recolours the yellow hm heart to pink instead
- Two box palettes: "vanilla" and "vintage"
- Choice of max heart having a bonus gold box
- Customizable; comes with templates folder so you can edit/recolour your own to match your custom UI’s

[b]REQUIREMENTS:
[/b]- SMAPI
- Content Patcher

[b]INSTALL:
[/b]- Install the latest version of SMAPI and Content Patcher
- Download and unzip file
- Place in your "\Stardew Valley\Mods" folder
- Run game with SMAPI

[b]UNINSTALL:
[/b]- Simply remove from mods folder

[b]CONFIG:
[/b]- Box: "vanilla", "vintage", "custom"
- Max Heart Box: "gold", "vanilla", "vintage", "custom"
- 1 to 9 Hearts: "stardew", "hm", "hm_pink", "sos", "custom"
- Max Heart: "stardew", "hm", "sos", "custom"

[b]CUSTOMIZE YOUR OWN:
[/b]- Go to "custom" folder
- Choose which hearts style template you want to use
- Open up the templates in an image editor (eg. Paint or Photoshop)
- Edit as much as you want
- Save your work and make sure file names stay the same
- Go to config and change options to “custom” for your changes to show the next time you load up your game!

[b]CREDIT:[/b]
[b]- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/34767255]ManaKirel[/url]'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1244]Vintage Interface[/url] for vintage box palette
- [url=http://mayorfuu.tumblr.com/]http://mayorfuu.tumblr.com/[/url]

Personal edits ok
Please do not reupload/redistribute[/b]
